approval_required_for: Bounded human approval is required only if validation cannot uniquely derive the exact current user-supplied sample-project wrapper/source identity or an authorized VCS compile authority from the current identity and Vivado-export evidence; no target, executable, wrapper, or path may be guessed.

consumes: case_board_interface_discovery pass evidence and its current user-supplied sample-project source-identity document
current immutable target checkpoint and target-layer selection
current frozen numeric comparison policy and tolerance
current exact board-wrapper and simulation-source hashes
certified lower-layer evidence as reusable context only
executable_actions.on_failure: Treat any missing complete-scope tensor hash, target-model reference run, frozen numeric policy, exact-wrapper/source binding, or generated testbench hash as a verification-capability blocker. Do not generate expected output from RTL/random data, sample weights, change tolerance, substitute a wrapper, run VCS, or patch lower-layer RTL.
produces: verification/board_simulation/board_tb.sv generated against the exact current sample-project wrapper only
executable_actions.rationale: Build the missing board-scope semantic capability without altering RTL, checkpoint, stimulus, numeric policy, tolerance, or the exact board-wrapper source hashes. The catalog and DUT-binding requirements cover every required Transformer-block tensor in every target layer only; expected outputs come from independent target-model inference over the identical immutable checkpoint and stimulus, never from random data or DUT output.

consumes: current exact board-wrapper and simulation-source hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep VCS, AXI/DDR execution, and all downstream gates blocked. Localize only catalog completeness, loader-to-DUT mapping, harness source hash, or exact-wrapper identity defects; preserve the immutable reference and numeric contracts and return to repair.board_semantic_harness_and_weight_binding_closure.
executable_actions.rationale: Re-execute the earliest failed current-layer gate using the newly hash-bound harness closure. This determines whether the complete Transformer-block tensor-to-loader-to-DUT binding and multilayer harness source closure are now valid before any board simulation or trace request.

consumes: verification/board_simulation/board_tb.sv generated against the exact wrapper
current exact wrapper and source hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: Do not guess wrapper names, paths, Vivado contexts, or simulator executables. If evidence is merely incomplete, repair the current board harness binding; if multiple plausible exact source identities or authorized compile authorities remain, stop and request bounded human approval. Do not interpret readiness failure as a kernel or AXI RTL failure.
executable_actions.rationale: Once the multilayer binding gate passes, repair the current board-layer simulation readiness gap by binding the VCS compile plan, authorized executables, and ordered authority references to the exact user-supplied sample-project identity and Vivado-export facts. This is a readiness/protocol action, not a hardware correctness or VCS-pass claim.

executable_actions.on_failure: Use the trace to identify the earliest violated current board boundary or harness/runtime contract and repair only that causal slice before replay. A lower-layer backtrack is permitted only if this fresh trace directly contradicts a named lower-layer certificate invariant with direct core start, ingress, egress, named causal-boundary, and current-certificate evidence; otherwise leave both certified lower layers closed.
executable_actions.rationale: After the pipeline and AXI/DDR readiness gates pass, run the required current-layer replay with the exact board wrapper, immutable reference artifacts, and monitors for accepted input handshake, core lifecycle start, ingress, egress, output/lifecycle frontier, ordering, and executed all-required-weight consumption. The certified kernel remains an elastic variable-latency pipeline: unequal stage durations are not failures when required boundary order and cross-token overlap are preserved.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep the board layer and all backend/bitstream/runtime work blocked. Return the first failing tool report and current replay trace to current-layer causal localization; do not weaken numeric comparison, alter the immutable inputs, treat AXI/prefetch activity as output progress, or reopen lower layers absent an explicit trace contradiction.
executable_actions.rationale: Only after a clean boundary-monitored functional replay, execute the remaining required board-layer gates and assemble fresh semantic evidence. This validates the exact board integration across multilayer function, deadlock/liveness, AXI protocol, DDR image ordering, and independent target-model numeric comparison without promoting to backend or board runtime.

consumes: sacg_memory_truth open retry requests retry_request.0136, retry_request.0140, retry_request.0141, and retry_request.0142
executable_actions.on_failure: Retain all existing barriers and open retries, mark the candidate evidence as non-promotable, and return to the first failed current-layer action. Do not consume rejected artifacts as validated inputs or advance to synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI, or board runtime.
executable_actions.rationale: Maintain SACG trust boundaries while transferring only fresh content-addressed board evidence back to Stage7. No retry-reconciliation contract was supplied for this repair pass, so this handoff must not declare prior rejected artifacts superseded or clear the 10 active contamination barriers and 4 open retries unless authoritative Stage7 evaluation accepts every required current board gate.

observations: real_tool.case_multilayer_pipeline directly failed with absent all-target-layer Transformer-block DUT weight binding and absent hash-verified multilayer harness sources. This is the earliest executable board-layer blocker.

The functional_sim failure is an aggregate precondition failure caused by the missing board testbench artifact and unmet prerequisites. VCS, VCS analysis, AXI/deadlock diagnostics, output ordering, numeric comparison, and DDR behavior have not executed, so no RTL, AXI, DDR, liveness, or output-frontier root cause is established.

The debug closure classifies this as a verification-capability gap and explicitly blocks hardware boundary tracing until the semantic testbench, loader/weight binding, numeric contract, and checker capability are repaired. Therefore a hardware RTL patch or a lower-layer replay is not currently authorized.

Certified lower-layer evidence remains live and reusable: operator-leaf certificate sha256 2bbc6880205155cbc1119882b2503281c2cb43b4b3c0d40a1754acb1e3a20569 and single-layer certificate sha256 44d3689d835f165fd30e794aeec2dabf648d1d65d17a24a53d3a6aac6e3854e7. No current hash-bound trace contradicts either certificate or the verified elastic kernel boundary-order/cross-token-overlap invariant.

The historical VCS diagnosis reporting zero accepted kernel output is not executable for this failure: its applicability binding is missing and it is dependency-skipped. It must not be used to diagnose or reopen the connected kernel. The prior repair-execution feedback also failed closed integrity validation and is not evidence of an applied repair.

sacg_memory_truth has 10 active same-scope contamination barriers and 4 open same-scope retry requests, with no open same-scope backtrack request. Rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts remain planning/debug evidence only and cannot support promotion. Historical active records involving case_board_interface_discovery do not override the current direct failure, because the current candidate reports that discovery gate as passed.
No conditional specialist was triggered; the deterministic router retained this bounded repair decision with the primary repair agent.
proposed_actions: Materialize a current board semantic-harness closure bound to the exact sample-project wrapper identity, immutable full Transformer-block checkpoint catalog, independent target-model reference, frozen numeric policy, and generated testbench hashes.
Rerun the multilayer-pipeline gate before simulator execution; if it remains failed, repair only the harness/loader/source-closure capability and do not request a hardware trace.

After pipeline pass, establish the exact-board AXI/DDR simulation readiness and VCS compile authority from the current source-identity document, then execute a current-layer boundary-monitored VCS replay.
Use replay evidence to localize only the earliest current-layer causal boundary. Reopen a lower layer only if the replay explicitly contradicts a certified lower-layer invariant.
If replay is clean, execute the remaining multilayer functional, deadlock, AXI protocol, DDR round-trip, and semantic-evidence gates; keep Stage7 and downstream promotion blocked on any failure.

Record fresh candidate evidence against the open SACG retries without clearing any active trust barrier unless all current board gates pass and the authoritative Stage7 state accepts the new evidence.
risks: Model and memory risk: a manifest without complete per-target-layer tensor hashes, loader mapping, and simulator-observed DUT consumption can falsely suggest that real checkpoint weights were used.

Numeric and data-order risk: expected outputs must be produced by independent target-model inference on the identical immutable checkpoint and stimulus; tolerance, mismatch policy, testbench contract, and stimulus cannot be changed to fit DUT output.

Board integration risk: generating a testbench or compile plan against a simplified wrapper, stale source identity, unauthorized executable, or unbound Vivado-export facts would invalidate board-level evidence even if simulation runs.

Runtime risk: independent AXI/prefetch activity is not output/lifecycle-frontier progress. A clean current-layer trace must observe accepted ingress, core lifecycle start, egress, ordering, and output behavior before any liveness conclusion.

Hierarchy risk: a downstream output symptom cannot reopen the certified connected kernel without a fresh hash-bound trace containing direct core start, ingress, egress, a named causal boundary, and evidence that contradicts a named lower-layer certificate invariant.
SACG trust risk: the active barriers and open retries prevent downstream consumption or promotion; a candidate repair artifact cannot self-certify or silently supersede rejected transitions.

constraints: immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy, tolerance, semantic-testbench contract, and exact board-wrapper source hashes
Transformer blocks only; embedding/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, and sampling are excluded
exact user-supplied sample-project wrapper and source identity; no simplified wrapper substitution
elastic_rate_insensitive_token_pipeline: preserve boundary order and cross-token overlap; do not require all stages to share start/end cycles
active SACG contamination barriers and open retry requests remain downstream-consumption blockers until a fresh accepted Stage7 result
edges: immutable checkpoint plus deterministic-or-real stimulus -> independent target-model Transformer-block reference -> complete tensor catalog -> loader/harness binding -> DUT consumption evidence -> case_multilayer_pipeline
case_multilayer_pipeline pass -> exact-board AXI/DDR simulation readiness -> current-layer VCS boundary replay -> multilayer/AXI/deadlock/DDR semantic closure

current board trace with direct core start, ingress, egress, named causal boundary, and current lower-certificate evidence -> conditional lower-layer backtrack only when it contradicts a certified invariant
all selected board gates pass with fresh evidence -> Stage7 retry reconciliation and only then downstream promotion eligibility

output.summary: Keep the board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system layer fail-closed. The earliest executed failure is a board-scope verification-capability gap in case_multilayer_pipeline: complete Transformer-block tensor-to-loader-to-DUT binding across all target layers and a hash-verified multilayer harness are absent; the exact-wrapper board testbench artifact is also absent. functional_sim is dependency-unsatisfied, not executed VCS/RTL/AXI/DDR/numeric/liveness evidence. Repair and validate the immutable current-layer semantic harness and board source-identity/compile closure first, then run the current-layer targeted VCS replay and remaining board gates. Do not reopen certified operator leaves or the elastic single-layer kernel unless a fresh hash-bound board trace directly contradicts a named lower-layer invariant.
